formula: salience(t) = AMI_relative_TF(t) * max(0, Brown_IDF(t) - AMI_meeting_IDF(t)); IDF=ln((N+1)/(DF+1)); weight=1+3*salience/max_development_salience
support: ASCII alphabetic tokens of length>=3, >=5 development occurrences, >=3 meetings, >=2 meeting series
alignment: Minimum weighted-cost token Levenshtein; no compound merging; match=0, deletion=w(reference), insertion=w(hypothesis), substitution=max(w(reference),w(hypothesis)); ties prefer diagonal then deletion then insertion
aggregation: 100 * sum(weighted edit cost) / sum(reference token weights)
normalizations: upstream English then fixed Snowball English v1
selection: Development-only parameters fixed before inspecting evaluation scores; exploratory metric, no claim of retrieval validation
boost_exclusion_policy: Development-reviewed conversational/function-word forms receive weight 1, not removal. Under stemming exclude their stems too. Fixed before any pilot weighted scoring.
